text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm the spring King of the Mile!

text_block_list.text: She ran that well in those conditions?!Just how much power does shehave?!

text_block_list.text:

job, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.text: Thanks! I won't back down for<n>nothin'!

text_block_list.text:

Trainer?

up next?

text_block_list.text:

the race that will give<n>everyone the best view of
that is...
choice_data_list: Next up is the Sprinters Stakes!
